svg.title: Gartner forecast: more than 40% of agentic AI projects abandoned by 2027
svg.desc: A stat callout showing Gartner's forecast that more than 40% of agentic AI projects will be abandoned by the end of 2027 due to escalating costs, unclear business value, and inadequate risk controls - a failure mode that hits build and buy decisions equally.
svg.text: Gartner forecast - agentic AI projects, by end of 2027
Share of agentic AI projects forecast to be abandoned
will be abandoned due to escalating costs, unclear
business value, and inadequate risk controls.
That failure mode hits build and buy decisions equally
